Players Committee card image of [[The First Order Was Just The Beginning]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “Deploy on table. Your [Episode VII] troopers are forfeit +1. Once per turn, if [Episode VII] Emperor on table, may ▼ Kijimi or place any three cards out of play from your Lost Pile to deploy a non-unique [Episode VII] trooper from Lost Pile. [Immune to Alter.]” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/c241f88/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual14-Dark/hires/thefirstorderwasjustthebeginning.png Images-HT/starwars/Virtual14-Dark/hires/thefirstorderwasjustthebeginning.png] as of commit c241f88 “vset14” (18 March 2021).
